system.description:
• Effect: Once per month, in a day-long ritual, you weave your greatest illusions into one work: a single nonmagical object, a being of Level up to half yours with all its powers, or an area of 10ft×10ft per level.
  • The being is friendly to you and follows your direction; the GM plays anything against its nature.
  • The work lasts until dispelled, and cannot be dispelled for 1 day per level except by a caster of your level or higher.
  • Only one can exist at a time.
  • Each work has a 1% chance per level of becoming permanently real: it can never be dispelled or disbelieved, and no longer counts as your one Magnum Opus.

activities.name: Magnum Opus
activities.text: Perform a day-long ritual to create any single object, being or area, with a 1% chance per level that it becomes permanently real.
